evidence.detail: The class is constructed only by the already-reviewed R145 rs/gui/J ClientSidebarPanel and installed on its JTabbedPane via addChangeListener.
stateChanged casts the event source to JTabbedPane, reads its selected index, then calls the active Launcher refresh/update method; no unrelated state or behavior exists.
The class stores only the synthetic ClientSidebarPanel owner and implements ChangeListener, fixing it as the tab-selection change listener for that side-panel surface.

proposals.note: Generated-listener name follows exact JTabbedPane attachment and launcher refresh behavior. R145's existing ClientSidebarPanel name is retained for the parent.
